How much will it cost to carpet my Lake Stevens house?

Figure $4–$7 per square foot installed. That figure includes the carpet, the pad, labor, new tack strip and getting the old carpet out of the house. A single bedroom in Lake Stevens usually comes in around $600–$1,000, and most whole-project tickets land between $2,400 and $3,900. The biggest swing is carpet grade — and you pick that at home, with our samples lying on the floor they'd replace.
Will the mobile carpet showroom really come out to Lake Stevens?

Yes — Lake Stevens is squarely in our service area. The van carries 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, whether you're downtown near North Cove, out by Frontier Village or up on Soper Hill. Samples go down in the rooms they'd cover so the colors read true, we measure the whole house, and the written price stays with you when the van leaves. The visit is free.
How much is carpet stretching in Lake Stevens?

Stretching starts at $99 per room, and most Lake Stevens rooms fall in the $99–$180 range. A power stretcher pulls out the ripples and buckles that build up after years of foot traffic — roughly a fifth of what replacement costs. It's the right call whenever the pile still stands up and the color still suits the room.
What do carpeted stairs cost in a Lake Stevens home?

Stairs start at $18 per step, finished waterfall-style or cap-and-band, and a typical full staircase lands in the $235–$400 range. Landings and pie-shaped winders get measured and priced in the original written quote, so the final invoice matches the number you approved before work started.
How long will carpet installation take at my Lake Stevens house?

One day for most Lake Stevens homes. Three or four bedrooms plus a staircase fits comfortably between morning drop-off and dinner. A big two-story with heavy furniture in every room can spill into a second day — and if yours will, that's written on the quote before installation starts, not discovered halfway through.
Do your installers handle the furniture?

Yes. On most jobs the crew moves the beds, dressers, couches and tables, then puts every piece back once the carpet is in. Your part is the small stuff — closet floors, electronics, lamps and anything breakable or sentimental you'd rather carry yourself.
Should I restretch my carpet or just replace it?

Restretch when the problem is ripples and the carpet itself is healthy — pile standing, backing sound, a color you can live with. That's a $99-per-room fix. Replace when traffic lanes are crushed flat, seams are letting go, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor returns after professional cleaning. We look first and tell you plainly which side of the line yours is on.
Which Lake Stevens neighborhoods do you work in?

All of them. Downtown and North Cove, Frontier Village, Soper Hill, Cavelero Hill, Lundeen, Hartford, Sunnycrest, Glenwood and Hillcrest are regular stops, and we cover Machias, Lochsloy, Lake Cassidy, Getchell, Three Lakes and Sisco Heights just outside the city — plus the rest of Snohomish County beyond that.
What's the best carpet for pets in a busy Lake Stevens house?

Solution-dyed nylon over a moisture-barrier pad. The color goes all the way through the fiber, so it stands up to hard scrubbing and even diluted bleach, and the sealed backing plus barrier pad keep accidents from soaking into the subfloor — which is how odor becomes permanent. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and both samples are in the van to compare.
What warranty backs a Lake Stevens carpet install?

Two layers of coverage. OC Flooring stands behind the workmanship — seams, stretch, tack-down — with a 1-year warranty, and the mill warranties the carpet itself, typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain depending on grade. Both go on your written quote. Worth knowing: too thin a pad can void a mill warranty, which is one more reason all three pad grades come to the measure.
